summary.text: Peter Harmon Williams, an independent write-in candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District to Ed Gallrein, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No campaign website, public statements, or biographical profile were found for this candidate.
